source.description: format of the source file next to these settings (same name); drop a new file to replace it

scale.description: uniform scale applied to vertices, bones and animation (0.01 for an FBX made in centimeters)

materials.description: import materials and their textures; off: meshes use the default material. Material files already there are kept on reimport

animations.description: import each animation as a clip (the skeleton comes too)

sampleRate.description: animation keyframes per second when baking
